CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: stdlib/video/nle.prn: non-linear-editing DSP for NOCK's MIXFORGE EDITOR video editor -- equal-power crossfade curves (mirroring mixforge/mixer.prn's own quarter-cos pan construction), a per-clip fade-in/fade-out envelope, and time-based MPC pad-capture window math. Compiled to wasm via the same pipeline MIXFORGE/scripts/build_dsp_wasm.sh established; verified with a real 14/14 kernel test in IDUNA/frontend/nock. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
